agent.reasons: The entity is located in Iran (IR), and so are all five identified individuals. Iran is a comprehensively sanctioned country, so SOP 6.1 requires a decline. The registry filing is dated 2025-11-16, more than 6 months before the 2026-10-27 review, which on its own would mean requesting documents under 3.5. Under 2.1 the more severe outcome, decline, governs. Ownership is complete (only Elif Petrov holds 25% or more, with 35%; Omar Yilmaz holds 18.4% indirectly). There is a control person, every identified individual's ID is verified, and screening found no sanctions, PEP or adverse media hits.
